lines.q: Which country is home to Machu Picchu?
lines.a: Peru! High in the Andes, built by the Inca.
The Seine! It runs right past the Eiffel Tower.

lines.q: Which is the largest US state?
lines.a: Alaska! More than twice the size of Texas.

lines.q: Which continent has the most countries?
lines.a: Africa, with fifty four! Asia has the most people, not the most countries.

lines.q: Whose national flag is not a rectangle?
lines.a: Nepal! Two stacked triangles, the only one like it.

lines.q: Last one. Which country has the most lakes?
lines.a: Canada! More than half of all the lakes on Earth. Think you got all six? Go again!
